description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Deploy the website: this is the step that makes the uploaded draft live at website_url. Publish only after the owner has seen the draft (preview_url in my_website) and said so; if they ask to deploy before seeing it, show them preview_url first. Runs the same page and browser checks as the dashboard and copies in any web images still on the draft. While the browser check is still running this answers publishing: true, and the site goes live by itself when the check passes. If it fails, or the draft changes first, nothing goes live, and my_website shows why.

rev.description: The rev the owner saw, so a draft that has changed since is not published

title: Publish my full website
